_note: Club-seasons where the man never made a first-team league appearance for that
club, and was not in its squad either -- a youth or trial spell that leaked
into the source. This is a different fault from a namesake merge and needs a
different fix: there is no second person to split off, the row simply should
It matters because a squad row is a teammate row. Alan Ball on Wolves' books
as a schoolboy makes him a one-step link to every Wolves player of 1961/62,
which is exactly the kind of false bridge this whole audit exists to remove.
Deliberately conservative. A row is only listed when a source says plainly
that no first-team appearance was made. The dataset legitimately records
squad members with zero league appearances -- being at a club and not playing
is a real thing it is meant to capture -- so 'played no games' on its own is
NOT grounds for deletion. Only 'was never in the first-team squad' is.
Each entry: uid, club code, season start year, and why.
